summary: Union Navy officer and rear admiral; John's 5th cousin 6x removed via Bull Smith.
bio:
Path: Deborah Smith (m. Maj. William Lawrence Jr.) → Daniel Lawrence (m. Mary Redwood) → Abraham → Elizabeth (m. Capt. Daniel H. Braine) → Abraham L. Braine → Daniel L. Commanded USS Monticello (Civil War), USS Juniata (Polaris search) and the South Atlantic Squadron.

Line in Lawrence 1858 ([R4-S1]): Deborah Smith & William Lawrence Jr. -> Daniel (d. 1757, m. Mary Redwood) -> Abraham (m. Mary Smith) -> Elizabeth (m. Capt. Daniel H. Braine) -> Abraham L. Braine (b. 1782, m. 1811 Agnes Dean Hamilton) -> Daniel Lawrence Braine, 'now lieutenant in the United States Navy', married 1855 Mary E. Fulton: 5th cousin 6 times removed.
